record.dic_text:
08274 Sherebyah {shay-rayb-yaw'}

源自 08273 和 03050; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Sherebiah 8; 8

示利比 = "耶和華已使成焦土"
1) 一位協助以斯拉宣講律法的利未人, 他也是在和尼希米所訂的公約上簽名的人之一
record.edic_text:
08274 Sherebyah {shay-rayb-yaw'}

from 08273 and 03050;; n pr m

AV - Sherebiah 8; 8

Sherebiah = "Jehovah has scorched"
1) a Levite who assisted Ezra at the reading of the Law and who
   sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
